summary: Tested Saffron Services Demo Booking flow end-to-end (backend + frontend). All 10 backend pytest cases pass for GET /api/saas/demo-request/availability and POST /api/saas/demo-request, including success, double-booking (409), past-date rejection (400), Sunday rejection (400), invalid slot (400), missing required fields (422), and Sunday/past availability returning empty. Playwright frontend run confirms all 3 CTAs (nav-book-demo-btn, hero-book-demo-btn, contact-book-demo-btn) navigate to /book-demo, the page shows all 3 steps, empty submit shows validation toast and does NOT post, Sundays are visibly disabled with line-through, picking a date triggers GET availability, and full e2e booking renders demo-confirmed. Back to home works.
critical_code_review_comments: BookDemoPage.js generates calendar from `new Date()` at render but useMemo with [] — fine for short sessions, but if a tab is left open across midnight the dates list goes stale. Low priority.
validate() runs only on submit; consider disabling submit button until required fields are filled to prevent toast-spamming. Minor UX nit.

On the confirmation screen ‘Book another’ resets confirmed/pickedDate/pickedSlot but keeps the submitted form contents — that is probably intentional, but the previous slotsByDate cache still holds the now-booked slot (next availability fetch will refresh once a different date is picked). Acceptable.
Backend availability endpoint exposes `weekday` and `booked_count` which is fine for debugging; not a leak.

POST /api/saas/demo-request creates a duplicate row in contact_leads collection — make sure the leads dashboard handles `lead_type=='demo_request'` so demo bookings don't double-count contact submissions.
seed_data_creation: Test inserted ~3 demo_requests rows with email test_bd@example.com / test_ui@example.com in db.demo_requests (and matching contact_leads). Used dates ~14-30 days in the future; safe to leave or clean up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are at /app/backend/tests/test_demo_request.py. They auto-pick fresh future weekdays so they are stable across days, but each run inserts ~3 demo_requests rows. Frontend e2e selects the middle slot of the chosen date to avoid clashing with backend tests that use first/last slots on different dates. Public URL is REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env.
rca of the issue: No issues found — all 13 specified test cases pass.
